description: Primer/oligo melting temperature: nearest-neighbor (SantaLucia 1998) at the supplied reaction conditions, recommended from 14 nt up, with the Wallace rule for shorter oligos, a fixed-100 mM-Na+ Schildkraut-Lifson reference estimate, and molecular weights.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

targetTm.description: Optional target Tm (°C). When given, the response includes a pass/fail gate.

tmTolerance.description: Allowed +/- window (°C) around targetTm for the gate.

name: melting_temperature
title: Primer Tm calculator
